status: LOCAL ONLY — not committed, pushed or deployed

layout.desktop: One compact status/next-destination row and a single slim five-stop line. Ordinary desktop panel about 145px. Wrapped labels at 1024px naturally grow to about 160px.
layout.mobile: About 157px collapsed at 320–768px; native button disclosure with aria-expanded and aria-controls reveals the route list. No fixed panel height, clipped copy, transitions or JS breakpoint expansion.
layout.details: Tracking details remain behind Details on desktop and within the expanded mobile route disclosure.

icon: Exact unchanged bus-front.svg used by the hosted Find Van button, alpha-masked crimson on pale yellow. See icon-provenance.json.
status_accuracy: Existing hasLiveJourneyPosition and valid ETA/phase guards retained; stale transport cannot claim LIVE.
Historical stop labels are Last known stop; delayed reported-stop copies also remain historical when no timeline node is marked current.
Route-only sequence uses Next on route; unreliable or missing ETA uses ETA unavailable.
Confirmed-passed ticks still require explicit checked/completed evidence; no positional inference from route order.
Upstream activity and supporting route-order explanation remain available in tracking details.

verification.browser_matrix: 49 state/width cases each in actual Chromium and Playwright WebKit (98 total), including 320px and long translated names. No horizontal overflow or clipped headings.
verification.interaction: Mouse and keyboard disclosure toggles and stop commands verified.
verification.hosted_map: Read-only hosted companion loaded with its framing headers, source, controls and bridge unmodified. Browser-only local Web App proxy under its already-approved origin, including local HMR forwarding. No deployment was used.
verification.map_resize: Iframe timeOrigin, dimensions and Leaflet map size preserved through expansion/collapse. Canvas size matches viewport after tablet/desktop/mobile width changes; tiles remain loaded.
verification.controls: Expanded route stop selection reaches the existing v1 child handler, disables follow and opens the stop popup. Find Van resumes follow; Find Me uses a synthetic browser location and disables follow; full Route, Stops/open-close, Interact/Done and Reload verified.

limitations: Device emulation and WebKit engine checks are not physical-device testing.
Live map screenshots reflect the public tracking data available during verification; they are not claims of a currently fresh van location.
publication: None. No database, provider configuration, tracking/GPS pipeline or independent companion source changes.
